DESIGN PLANS — DATA CENTER FACILITY
Project: Tier III Data Center — Sacramento, CA
Equipment Schedule Reference: ES-001 through ES-012
Cooling System: Precision air cooling units, 500kW total IT load
ASHRAE Environmental Class: A2 per ASHRAE 9.9-2021
Cooling Load Spec: 500kW design IT load, 1.4 PUE design target
Suppression System: Clean agent FM-200 per NFPA 2001
Equipment Model: CRAC-DC-500-X
Standard Reference: NFPA 75 2020 / NFPA 76 2020 / ASHRAE 9.9-2021
